project_type: Expo SDK 54 custom-dev-build React Native + TypeScript app (iOS-focused) with a local Swift Expo native module and an Expo config plugin that injects a DeviceActivityMonitor app-extension target via raw pbxproj mutation. Pre-existing content catalog (content/tracks.json) + a Node validator script are preserved untouched.
language: TypeScript 5.9.3 (strict) for JS/TS; Swift for the iOS native module + extensions
build_system: npm 11.7.0 on Node v20.19.4, lockfile package-lock.json. iOS project is a regenerable prebuild artifact produced by `npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean`. Quirk: the DeviceActivityMonitor extension target is NOT created by any high-level @expo/config-plugins helper; it is hand-built with the withXcodeProject escape hatch driving the bundled xcode@^4.0.0 pbxproj library (see FEAT-003).
test_framework: jest via jest-expo@54.0.18 preset (jest.config.js: preset 'jest-expo'); tests live in __tests__/
build_command: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit, strict) and npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean, then xcodebuild for the iPhone 16 simulator with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
verification_instructions: Run from /Users/Shared/goalie: (1) npm install -> resolves, writes package-lock.json; (2) node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs -> prints 'Course catalog structure valid: 3 tracks, 3 levels each.'; (3) npm run typecheck -> passes (tsc --noEmit strict); (4) npm run lint -> passes (eslint .); (5) npm test -> 5 named loadCatalog tests + placeholder-contract tests + availability tests pass; (6) npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean -> generates ios/ with entitlements, app group, DeviceActivityMonitor (+ optional ShieldConfiguration) targets; (7) compile ceiling: WS=$(ls -d ios/*.xcworkspace); SCHEME=$(xcodebuild -list -workspace "$WS" -json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const a=JSON.parse(s).workspace.schemes;console.log(a.find(x=>x==="Goalie")??a[0])})'); xcodebuild -workspace "$WS" -scheme "$SCHEME" -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build -> BUILD SUCCEEDED.
snapshot_or_generated_files: package-lock.json is produced by npm install and committed. ios/ is produced by expo prebuild and is treated as a regenerable prebuild artifact (whether to commit it is a later-phase decision; Phase 1 does not depend on committing it).
environment_constraints: macOS, Node v20.19.4, npm 11.7.0, Xcode 16.4 (16F6). Only installed iOS SDK is 18.5 (device+simulator). iPhone 16 simulator available (also 16 Pro / Pro Max / Plus / 16e). HARD CONSTRAINT: no physical iPhone, no paid Apple Developer account, no Family Controls entitlement; the simulator cannot run Screen Time / Family Controls / ManagedSettings / DeviceActivity. On-device blocking is REAL native code but COMPILE-ONLY verifiable here and MUST be reported UNVERIFIED at runtime. Never fake a blocked state; never simulate blocking with a JS timer. Do NOT hardcode an SDK patch in the xcodebuild destination; let xcodebuild pick the installed runtime. Git: branch main, local-only, NO remote, NO worktree; work directly on main; commit locally only if everything builds; never push.
contribution_requirements: Keep content/tracks.json and scripts/validate-catalog.mjs intact (the domain layer READS tracks.json, never rewrites it; the existing validator must keep passing). Keep .kiro tracked. All pins in design.md section 2 are EXACT and locked once approved. The design at /Users/Shared/goalie/.agents/tasks/design.md is FIXED/approved and is the source of truth; do not redesign.
key_patterns: content/domain/ui separation: src/domain/ is PURE TS (no react/react-native/Node-IO imports); loadCatalog(raw: unknown): Catalog re-validates fail-fast and never returns partials. Availability layer is async with synchronous guards first (steps 1-4) and only step 5 awaits the native bridge; precedence NotIOS -> Simulator -> ExpoGo(module absent) -> OSTooOld -> NotAuthorized; fail-closed. Native<->extension communicate ONLY through app-group UserDefaults using the single shared GoalieFocusConstants.swift literals; FamilyActivitySelection serialized as encoded Data; tokens never cross the JS bridge. startFocusSession ordering invariant: schedule expiry BEFORE applying shields.
relevant_files: /Users/Shared/goalie/content/tracks.json (content source of truth; schemaVersion 1, 3 tracks x 3 levels; READ-ONLY)
/Users/Shared/goalie/scripts/validate-catalog.mjs (existing validator; must keep passing; mirror its structural invariants)
/Users/Shared/goalie/app.config.ts (Expo config: name Goalie, slug goalie, bundle com.goalie.app, app group group.com.goalie.app.focus, registers withGoalieFocus + expo-build-properties)
directory_structure: Root holds Expo config (app.config.ts, package.json, tsconfig.json, babel.config.js, jest.config.js, eslint.config.js, index.ts, App.tsx). content/ (existing, unchanged) holds tracks.json. scripts/ (existing) holds validate-catalog.mjs. src/domain/ is pure TS (content/, assessment/, rewards/, progression/, certificates/). src/focus/ is the JS side of the native module + availability layer. src/ui/ holds navigation/ + screens/. modules/goalie-focus/ is the local Expo native module (Swift ios/, plugin/, index.ts). ios-extensions/ holds the extension Swift sources templated into ios/ by the plugin. docs/ holds ios-focus-setup.md. __tests__/ holds jest tests. ios/ is a regenerable prebuild artifact.
